newsitem.title: NIGER: Public sector workers strike in Niger.
newsitem.headline: Public sector workers strike in Niger.

text.p: Public sector workers in the West African state of Niger stayed away from work for a second successive day on Thursday to demand back pay and press other grievances.

Witnesses said that the strike call by the USTN trades union grouping was largely followed both on Wednesday and Thursday. Postal and telecommunications workers returned to work, having planned all along to limit their action to one day.
Hospitals and health centres provided reduced services and schools stayed closed.
Impoverished Niger has 40,000 public sector workers but the government struggles to make ends meet.
The strikers oppose planned job losses in the public sector, want five months of back pay and a block on privatisation of companies where the staff reject the idea.
